about: Outfits shown or marked by Gentleman's Gazette, read from their published photos (the photos themselves are not kept here). gg: tick or better = approved by GG, cross or worse = marked wrong, shown = an example in an article. People are letters, and no names, photos or links are kept; their colourings were estimated by eye and measured from white-referenced photos. The full record, with the photos, is kept privately outside the repository.
